tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Board and page background; the ground under windows, frames and the floating top bar buttons.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Windows, panels, inputs, the Usage strip and the background-agent hint.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Floating things: menus, popovers, dialogs. In dark it is one step lighter than surface, which is how dark shows 'lifted'.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hovered and keyboard-active rows, ghost-button hover, selected rows in lists and the Settings nav.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on ground, surface, raised and hover (16:1 light, 11:1+ dark). Also the primary button fill, focused window border, Toast fill and the pressed arrange icon.

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink: primary button label, Toast text, pressed arrange icon, active history chip.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, branch names, shortcut hints, Idle/Exited status, idle and exited lamps. 4.5:1+ on ground, surface, raised and hover in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px separators and the outline of windows, menus, dialogs, panels and the side-panel rail.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons, inputs, radio and the workspace frame; dots of the board grid. Below 3:1 against surface in both themes (1.5:1): the source keeps controls quiet on purpose, so never use it as the only cue that something is a control.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Separators inside menus, title bars and panel sections.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Text that needs you: 'Waiting', '2 waiting', 'Needs you' bookmark fill, conflict letters, risk text in dialogs, Usage context at 85%+. 4.5:1 on ground, surface, raised and attention-soft; 4.3:1 on hover in light (flagged).

tokens.name: on-attention
tokens.usage: Text on an attention fill (the 'Needs you' bookmark).

tokens.name: attention-soft
tokens.usage: Pale yellow row fill for a waiting row in BoardNav, the group sidebar and lists. ink, muted and attention text all pass on it.

tokens.name: status-running
tokens.usage: Green lamp (Running) and the Running / 'n running' text. As text 4.7:1 on ground in light; 4.3:1 on hover in light (flagged).

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: Yellow lamp (Waiting) and the waiting window border. Graphics only, never text: use attention for the words. 3.1:1 on surface but 2.9:1 on ground in light (flagged: the top-bar lamp sits on ground).

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Red lamp (Error) and the 'Error · exit 1' text, failed background agents, error transcript lines.

tokens.name: guide
tokens.usage: Board layout only: alignment guides, spacing and size labels while dragging, the Usage strip while dragged, selected-window outline and the marquee. Never a status.

tokens.name: plugin-auto-approve
tokens.usage: Auto-approve plugin only: the bookmark under a terminal and the frame-title tag. Same red as error but means 'this approves for you'.

tokens.name: plugin-auto-approve-fg
tokens.usage: Text on plugin-auto-approve (5.4:1 light, 4.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: agent-claude
tokens.usage: claude: terracotta. Agent identity colour (2026-10-26): only on marks that say which agent this is, today the square mark and the text of the agent heading in the HISTORY sidebar. Never a status, never a fill or border elsewhere. Hue and lightness kept apart from the status green, yellow and red, the Auto-approve red and the guide blue. As text it passes 4.5:1 on surface and hover in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring on every control.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal dialogs and the in-window Stop-and-close confirm.

tokens.name: mascot
tokens.usage: Clawd the mascot's body, bottom left. Decoration, never a status.

tokens.name: mascot-eye
tokens.usage: Clawd's eyes (dark in both themes, to read on the orange body).

tokens.name: mascot-prop
tokens.usage: What Clawd holds (barbell, laptop, bowl).

tokens.name: mascot-food
tokens.usage: The food in Clawd's bowl.

families.ui: "Inter Variable", Inter, "PingFang SC", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: menus, dialogs, buttons, top bar (text-md).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Project name in the top bar and the frame header.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Window title bar, side panels, lists, small buttons (text-sm).

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: ⌘J ⌘⇧J jump to the terminal waiting for you
styles.usage: Hints, menu hints, shortcut hints, Usage strip, tags (text-xs).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase group headings: menu heading, SOURCE CONTROL, BOARD.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Sidebar sub-headings (TERMINALS, BACKGROUND · READ-ONLY) and the history agent label. 10px sits outside the 11/12/13/15 scale; the code uses it for these headings only.

styles.name: plugin-mark
styles.usage: Plugin marks hung on a window edge (Auto-approve bookmark, background-agent hint). Not a fifth step of the scale.

styles.name: window-name
styles.usage: Window name in the title bar (agent or command).

styles.name: branch
styles.usage: Branch names, paths, hashes, inputs in dialogs.

styles.name: code-small
styles.usage: Summary card lines, approval rows, transcripts, guide labels.

styles.name: terminal
styles.usage: Terminal screen (xterm.js) and its zoomed-out text snapshot.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Gaps between icon buttons, list rows.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Menu padding, tight gaps, panel inset from the window edge.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Default gap in rows and title bars; menu item padding.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Section padding in panels; title bar left padding; frame header padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Offset of the Auto-approve bookmark and the background hint from the window corner; toast bottom offset.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Dialog padding and the gap before its button row. 20 is also the board's dot-grid pitch and the gap between windows and between frames.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Second indent level in BoardNav.

tokens.name: radius-inset
tokens.usage: Highlights inside a rounded container: menu items, tags, address field.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Windows on the board, group sidebar, transcript window.

tokens.name: radius-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The right side panel and its collapsed rail.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: Workspace frames. No square corners anywhere in the UI.

tokens.name: plugin-mark-radius
tokens.usage: Bottom corners of a plugin mark hung under a window.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only things that float: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts, a focused or dragged window.

tokens.name: shadow-mark
tokens.usage: Plugin marks stuck to a window edge (the Usage strip). Much lighter than shadow-float.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, icon buttons in title bars and the top bar, arrange icons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs; panel header rows.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Menu items and list rows.

tokens.name: plugin-mark-height
tokens.usage: Auto-approve bookmark and background-agent hint under a terminal.

tokens.name: plugin-strip-height
tokens.usage: Usage strip height.

tokens.name: plugin-strip-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between the Usage strip and the window edge.

tokens.name: text-xs
tokens.usage: Captions, hints, tags.

tokens.name: text-sm
tokens.usage: Title bars, panels, small buttons.

tokens.name: text-md
tokens.usage: Default UI size.

tokens.name: text-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog titles only.

tokens.name: plugin-mark-text
tokens.usage: Plugin marks only.

tokens.name: leading
tokens.usage: Default line height.

tokens.name: weight-regular
tokens.usage: Body text.

tokens.name: weight-medium
tokens.usage: Primary button, window name, status counts.

tokens.name: weight-strong
tokens.usage: Titles, project names, headings, plugin marks.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and menu items; the idle branch icon on the panel rail.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus (above dialogs).

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast viewport (above everything).
